owner_post_only_center_shift_screen.reason: Distinct AB205 header bores overlap at 5/10 mm and remain below the 3D same-row spacing minimum at 15 mm; physical kerf-right inner kicker support gets worse as posts move outward

br904_fixed_center_pose_screen.half_inch_reason: At assumed 34.5-mm bend-to-near-hole offset, 1/2-inch bolt has -0.207-mm ray-only search margin after nominal factory-hole radial play. Moving to the 34.659-mm threshold leaves only about 0.058 mm further lateral allowance under the conditional 4D row screen, before other errors. This is not a formal NDS oblique-end rejection.
br904_fixed_center_pose_screen.seven_sixteenths_reason: The nominal 9/16-inch factory hole is 1/8 inch larger than a 7/16-inch bolt, exceeding the ordinary 2024 NDS 12.1.3.2 maximum 1/16-inch oversize; its wider geometric band is a diagnostic, not an installable schedule.

ordinary_stock_scope_contingency.reason: Owner explicitly chose factory connectors only. Ordinary Lowe's-listed ASTM A36 angle stock would require cutting and drilling and cannot be a candidate connector under that scope.

bounded_factory_material_follow_up.checked_2026_09_19: ABB Superstrut ZAB205EG-10 remains an exact Home Depot factory-made four-hole retail model with a nominal 1/4-inch plate and nominal hole centers. The inspected ABB catalog and product entry do not guarantee its steel grade, minimum base thickness, formed-bend resistance, or a wood-joint rating; its channel rating does not transfer. No exact alternative checked in this bounded follow-up closed those requirements.
bounded_factory_material_follow_up.orientation_caution: The 1-5/8-inch plate width does not by itself rule out a 1-1/2-inch-thick 2x6: in the center trial the plate width lies along the 5-1/2-inch broad face, not across the 1-1/2-inch thickness. Judge each installed orientation against its actual CAD faces and holes.
